== Summary ==
Chris Stevenson, one of the final 12 of the 1999 [[Star Trek CCG]] World Championship (Christopher Stevenson on the page). Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
